scientific_question: How sparse can scheduled record repair become before uninterrupted maintenance deteriorates?
reason: Nine evenly spaced repairs lost only one of 222 common-first-pass lineages versus eighteen repairs. The warning did not improve on that near-ceiling schedule.

posthoc_observations.interpretation: Warning expenditure is concentrated late. This is a diagnostic association, not a demonstrated cause of failure.

proposed_next_work: Brief paired repair/no-repair replays at saved failure boundaries, using identical injury/noise, to separate missed opportunities from failures already unrescuable at that boundary. Exposed-case mechanism audit only.
Frozen development budget curve on the existing exposed cohort: new evenly spaced arms with 1, 3 and 6 calls; reuse verified 9-call and 18-call trajectories.
Use the curve to specify one quantitative budget prediction and a separately frozen fresh-cohort comparison. Do not choose a practical margin or confirmatory sample size from convenience alone.
primary_population: All 256 records; report maintenance among shared first-pass lineages separately, without changing enrollment.
